caption:
Your leads live in four different places. That's the problem.

A text thread here. A Facebook comment there. A voicemail nobody's checked since Tuesday. A name on a sticky note by the register. Most shops run their pipeline scattered like this, which means nobody can see who still needs a reply.

Black Arrow OS puts every lead in one pipeline: New, Contacted, Quoted, Won. See the whole list in one screen instead of hunting across apps.

It's free. No signup wall, no card. Load this week's leads into it and see what's been sitting untouched.

rationale: Promo-style single images still book the fastest DM response for one clear ask, and Black Arrow OS returns to rotation with an unclaimed 'scattered lead channels' pain distinct from its prior lost-lead and morning-check angles.
